Definition: to be strong; causatively, to strengthen, i.e. (figuratively) to save (by flight)
BiblicalUsage: Before the hail, Pharaoh is told to gather his cattle and all that is in the field, and in Isaiah the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the real sense here is flight to safety, not muscle: the word is used of cattle hurried under cover and of a town emptying before an army, and God warns before He strikes so that the fleeing have somewhere to run.
